permissions.mcp:access: Connect AI agents to the Backoffice MCP server
permissions.mcp:approve: Review, approve and reject changes submitted by MCP tools
permissions.mcp:audit:read: Read the MCP tool call audit log

AllowSelfApproval.title: Allow self-approval
AllowSelfApproval.description: When enabled, a user can approve a change that they requested themselves. Disabled by default: a change must be approved by another user.

PendingChangeLifetimeHours.title: Pending change lifetime (hours)
PendingChangeLifetimeHours.description: A change that is not reviewed within this time expires and can no longer be approved.

Enabled.title: Audit MCP tool calls
Enabled.description: Record every tool call made through an MCP scope: the user, the tool, the outcome and the duration.

LogArguments.title: Record tool call arguments
LogArguments.description: Store the arguments of each tool call in the audit log. Disable if tool arguments may contain personal data.

Enabled.title: Clean up MCP data
Enabled.description: Periodically delete old audit entries and reviewed pending changes.

Cron.title: Cleanup schedule
Cron.description: When the cleanup runs, in UTC.

AuditRetentionDays.title: Audit retention (days)
AuditRetentionDays.description: Audit entries older than this are deleted.

PendingChangeRetentionDays.title: Pending change retention (days)
PendingChangeRetentionDays.description: Applied, failed, rejected and expired changes older than this are deleted. Approved changes that never completed are kept.
